summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze the supplier/ERP data drop, find where the Sunday 20:00 launch actually breaks, and build a general recheck-and-act agent product (poller, extraction, verifier, routines, calm Today UI) with supporting briefings and interview prep.
summary.outcome: Found that Soony's plan says all ok while the Collector's Edition misses launch (overbooked art books, failed statues) and Standard is short on game cards (6,800). Built and committed a calm Today flow with email review, routines with a When/Then/Always diagram, voice two-step decisions and a verifier fix, pushed to branch jonas/today-flow; the final restyle commit was still in progress.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) and no notification/webhook; data changes silently, with existing files replaced under the same name, so change detection must poll and compare SHA-256 checksums.
Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ (raw, drops, notes, state, design); .env is gitignored, .env.example is committed with an empty SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN.
Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md exist in the repo; claim tasks in PROGRESS.md and run required Entire/Brain checks before pushing.
Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change; sessions with no modifications log 'skipping checkpoint', and checkpoints are pushed along with git push.

Shortfall verifier counts inbound only when the supplier document confirms it, and the image recognizer may put the part number in the `item` field rather than `material_id`, so a fallback mapping was needed.
New routines now default to 'ask' mode (prepare, one-tap send); existing routines keep their mode; legacy code-only routines have no recipe and cannot render a diagram.
Voice decisions use a two-step prepare/decide flow with a one-time token; the frontend blocks `decide` unless the person spoke since the last prepare.

Front end is web/src/components with Today.tsx, TopBar.tsx, routines/ components (FlowGraph, Diagram, RoutineCard), and web/src/lib/today.ts holding all derived wording; routes are /, /d/<id>, /plan, /suppliers, /routines.

code.finding: Each part now carries `arriving` and `not_counted` lists, and gap = needed − usable − arriving; unread shipping documents are conservatively not counted.
Wide view restructured into When/Then/Always lanes that wrap; the narrow vertical view is unchanged.
Remaining verifier gaps: the 'runs dry' time still ignores arrivals and impact/__main__.py does not print the arriving list.

workflow: Use parallel subagents with clearly separated file ownership for front-end rebuilds, and verify with Playwright screenshots on mocked state, plus view-only checks on live data.
Ask before any paid API call; the user approved a one-off OpenAI image read costing a fraction of a cent.
Do not send real supplier emails during testing; mock POSTs, and open review dialogs without pressing Send.
Keep confidential data out of git and out of code; stage analysis notes in gitignored data/notes.

friction: Hooks seemed not to fire because Entire skips checkpoints when no repo files changed.
Dashboard stayed at 34,800 game-card shortfall until the shipping advice was read by the recognizer and a field-mapping fix was added.
Teams header emoji replacement missed a multi-line occurrence and had to be fixed directly.
Undo was offered for emails that had already been sent, and the voice assistant announced a plan but then just said 'done' without a confirmation step.
Legacy code-only routines had no diagram and one failed on outdated building blocks, so the user saw no flow graph.
Flow/Steps/Expanded views for routines were redundant and were consolidated into one.
The Standard stop time was initially attributed to the wrong card; it comes from clear cases waiting at the port.
The live app could not be rebuilt while another builder's files did not compile.
open_items: Push the restyle and automation commits to jonas/today-flow; PR #5 into main still holds an older state and needs merging or replacing.
Run an end-to-end live voice call test; show_on_screen and the voice flow were not tested with a mic.
Voice-confirmed sends use the original draft, since `decide` takes no edited text.
On phone, approving a no-cost option sends a real supplier email immediately, which is risky for the demo.
Plan view only got new colours and remains dense.
Hand-in by Sunday 12:00 still needs a README section, demo script, 3-minute video and deck.
Register sender email addresses in the portal Settings and reply to the Karton Nowak offer and the Boise terms, then watch whether replies create portal files.
Delete data/state.json and other confidential snapshots after the hack, and consider changing the portal password that was posted in Discord.
Verifier's 'runs dry' time and the impact CLI arriving list are left for Farhan.
